## Feature Proposal
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature.

## Problem Statement & Motivation
What limitation or research question does this feature address? (e.g. cross-domain domain generalization, occlusion handling, inference latency reduction).

## Proposed Architecture / Method
Explain how this should be implemented:
- Network backbone or attention mechanism
- Mathematical formulation of proposed loss function or distance metric
- Expected improvement on Rank-1 / mAP benchmarks

## Alternatives Considered
What alternatives have you explored?

## References & Papers
Links to arXiv papers, official implementations, or benchmarks.
